notes.title: One year of DELUGE! - 50% off + V.1.6.2 out now!
notes.content:
Here's a bunch of news and updates to the game. We're almost a year into the game being out and that's very exciting to me. Thank you! :)

I HAVE FIXED MORE BUGS
First thing's first... there's a new, minor update to the game. I started to see this error pop up in a couple of new playthroughs, so I had to jump at it and fix quickly! When you would leave an unlocked area (after the 'chest room') the game would crash and identify "Invalid Map Event ID: 69" which, while a funny error, this was breaking the game, so it had to go!

v.1.6.2 - Thanks for sticking with me through the development cycle! :)
- Fixed a funny bug: "Invalid Map Event ID: 69" :)
- Fixed a couple of mapping inconsistencies
- Minor updates to dialog speed/expressions
- Minor graphic updates

Thank you to everyone who pointed the errors they saw out to me and for sticking through the game despite it!

DELUGE IS FEATURED ON RPGMAKER.NET FOR OCTOBER
I'm really grateful to RPGMaker.net for choosing DELUGE as the featured game for the month of October on their website. I've been a fan of this site and a member of its community since its inception and it means a lot to be supported by such an awesome community. Many other RPG Maker 2003 developers (and beyond) have become genuine friends, and for that I am grateful. Thanks guys!

DELUGE IS DISCOUNTED ON STEAM
Furthermore, starting today, the game will be available on Steam for a short time for 50% off! That's a nice, spooky horror RPG for the season for only $1 USD! The sale lasts for a short time only, so if you haven't picked up the game yet, I hope you'll consider doing so!

DELUGE IS ABOUT TO BE A YEAR OLD!
I'm working on a short piece to honor and celebrate a year of DELUGE on Halloween, October 31, but until then....

See ya!

notes.title: Now in widescreen (and updated!) - v.1.6
notes.content:
Thanks for sticking with me through the development cycle! 

Stay tuned, hoping there's no issues with making such a massive update to the display. This was a massive undertaking at first and I'm sure it will require a little bit of TLC here and there, but as far as I can tell - the update is done. :)

DELUGE v.1.6 - 9/27/22
Updated to new widescreen resolution - thanks Giznads!
Fixed a bug where the dog would glitch in the ending - thanks Joalr0!
Updated credits - thanks @hotgamerdad & @thegreatperhaps :)
Updated to new version of exe file with Maniacs patch
Adjusted dialog/interaction/combat textboxes for widescreen
Title screen adjusted to include [F5] for settings notice
Mapping updated for lighting/blending errors
Revised the way the game totals your completion percentage
Adjusted interaction indicator graphics in some places
Added flavor text to paintings, barrels, decorations
Revised final altercation with Ganglim	
Revised meeting in shop with Kenneth
Fixed a small bug that let you "meet" Ganglim on the balcony :0)
Fixed minor object interaction errors
Fixed minor mapping errors/inconsistencies


Additionally, the full soundtrack is available to stream on YouTube! Individual tracks will eventually be launching on streaming services in the next week or so. They've been submitted and approved, it's all on the platforms to launch now. :)
